summary: Final production-hardening validation for La Maison d'Auben in Stripe TEST mode. Expanded suite from 31 to 46 pytest tests — all 46 PASS. Executed a fresh real hosted-checkout purchase (card 4242, FR) end-to-end which succeeded on cs_test_a1FME0hmnUE8cgA3P8jcaKuQuqwhUlzYU2FGbFkMmaHwi43gnrlZ28POCe, showing 7,99 € on /paiement/succes and providing a valid download_token. Verified every review-request guarantee: (T1) happy-path chain OK — checkout→paid→by-session→download streams Budget-mensuel.xlsx (~1MB spreadsheetml.sheet, attachment Content-Disposition, amount=7.99 EUR from Stripe session.amount_total). (T2 CRITICAL) Unpaid session ⇒ GET /api/orders/by-session/{sid}=404, GET /api/payments/status/{sid}=pending, admin/orders count==0 — server correctly refuses delivery on non-paid sessions. (T3/T4) Single order per paid session across repeated status/by-session hammering. (T5) 10 concurrent GET /api/orders/by-session on same paid sid ⇒ still exactly 1 order (DuplicateKeyError guarded by unique session_id index). (T6/7/8/9) Valid token=200 xlsx stream; bogus token=404; /api/media/{paid_xlsx_path}=404 (only db.media images served). (T10) All admin endpoints (orders, newsletter, messages, upload/image, orders/{id}/resend-email) return 401 without Bearer; login admin@lamaisondauben.fr / Auben2026! works. (T11) POST /api/payments/checkout with amount/price/unit_amount in body → 200; extra fields silently ignored (Pydantic model_config default); Stripe session amount stays authoritative 7.99. (T12) POST /api/admin/orders/{id}/resend-email on the freshly-seeded post-fix order → 200 with email_status field; order NOT duplicated; separate email_status + owner_email_status fields present on the order (owner_email_status='sent', email_status='failed' because customer test_auben_1790322180@gmail.com is not on the preview Emergent /email/send allowlist — expected in preview, not a code bug). RATE LIMITING: 6+ POST /admin/login → 429 after 5; POST /contact → 429 after 5; POST /newsletter → 429 after 10; POST /checkout → 429 after 20 (per X-Forwarded-For IP, 60s sliding window). UPLOAD VALIDATION: .txt to /admin/upload/image → 400; empty file → 400; valid .png → 200; .exe to /admin/products/budget-mensuel/file → 400 (Extension non autorisée). ERRORS: /products/does-not-exist-xyz → {'detail':'…'} only, no traceback/paths/secrets, French message; bogus session_id 404 also {'detail':...} only. REGRESSION: 6 products incl. 'Suivi sportif', 8 categories with 'sport' & no 'investissement', budget-mensuel price=7.99 + main_image, articles/faq/settings 200, boot log 'Stripe initialisé | mode=test | cle=test' present.

minor.issue: Customer confirmation e-mail returns 422 for arbitrary gmail.com recipients in preview (recipient allowlist behaviour of the preview email service). Order still persisted correctly, email_status='failed' as expected, resend endpoint returns 200 with the attempted status. Re-verify with the production Resend domain.

Paid orders created BEFORE this iteration's code refactor lack email_status/owner_email_status fields (documents pre-date the field additions). Not a regression — all new orders (verified with cs_test_a1FME0h...) carry both fields. Consider a one-off backfill migration before going live if legacy TEST rows are kept.

action_items: (Optional) Backfill email_status='sent'/owner_email_status='sent' on legacy paid TEST orders (those without these fields) so the admin dashboard displays consistent delivery state across old and new orders.

(Pre-live) When switching STRIPE_MODE=live, re-run this 46-test suite; the boot-log assertion will need the 'mode=live | cle=live' variant, and the customer-email 422 issue should disappear once using the production Resend domain.
critical_code_review_comments: fulfill_order correctly gates order creation on Stripe s.payment_status=='paid' (server-side authority) — a bare s.status=='complete' never triggers delivery. Verified via TEST 2 (unpaid session ⇒ 404 & zero orders).

Idempotency: unique index on orders.session_id + upsert with $setOnInsert + DuplicateKeyError catch; res.upserted_id gates email side-effects. Verified with 10 concurrent by-session calls yielding exactly 1 order.

Emails: separate email_status and owner_email_status with atomic claim ({'$in':['pending','failed']} → 'sending') prevents double-send and stays retryable — confirmed via admin/orders/{id}/resend-email returning 200 without duplicating the order.

Amount authority: /api/payments/checkout uses stripe.Price.list(lookup_keys=...) → line_items.price=price.id and tax_behavior='inclusive'; Order.amount = session.amount_total/100 — no client-supplied field is ever trusted. Pydantic CheckoutInput's default ignore-extra policy silently drops attempted amount/price overrides (returns 200 instead of 422 — acceptable since server-side price is authoritative).

Rate limiter: in-memory sliding window keyed by bucket+X-Forwarded-For — thresholds match spec (5 admin_login / 5 contact / 10 newsletter / 20 checkout per 60s). Note: state is per-process in-memory, so with multiple backend workers behind a load balancer the effective limit is threshold × worker_count; consider Redis-backed limiter for production HA. Not a preview blocker.

Upload validation: extension + size + MIME + sanitize_filename; empty file rejected; .txt/.exe rejected with French detail. /api/media only serves db.media (images), so uploaded product files are unreachable via that route — only /api/download/{token}.

Global @app.exception_handler(Exception) returns generic French 500 {'detail': 'Une erreur interne est survenue. Réessayez plus tard.'} — no stack trace / internal paths / secrets leak. HTTPException details are all French phrases.
CORS via CORS_ORIGINS env with '*' → allow_origin_regex='.*' + allow_credentials=True (preview only); production should switch to explicit https://auben-preview-shop.emergent.host list.

Two additional unpaid checkout sessions created by TEST 2 & TEST 11 (no orders should exist for those).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite now has 46 tests grouped in TestPublicContent, TestNewsletterContact, TestPayments, TestAdminAuth, TestTaxInclusiveAndOwnerNotified. New tests since iter_4: test_unpaid_session_no_order_and_by_session_404, test_concurrent_by_session_no_duplicate, test_admin_endpoints_require_bearer, test_checkout_ignores_extra_amount_fields, test_resend_email_and_separate_status_fields, test_rate_limit_{admin_login,contact,newsletter,checkout}, test_upload_image_{rejects_txt,rejects_empty,accepts_png}, test_upload_product_file_rejects_exe, test_error_response_is_french_only, test_bogus_session_status_french_detail. Rate-limit tests use unique X-Forwarded-For IPs (203.0.113.11..14) so they don't collide with each other across runs. To trigger another real purchase, POST /api/payments/checkout then automate Stripe hosted checkout — the reliable selectors are input#email, input[name='cardNumber'|'cardExpiry'|'cardCvc'|'billingName'], select[name='billingCountry']→'FR', then button[data-testid='hosted-payment-submit-button']; wait_for_url '**/paiement/succes**'.
rca of the issue: N/A — all production-hardening security guarantees hold. Only remaining preview-only limitation is Emergent /email/send returning 422 for non-owner gmail recipients (allowlist), which will disappear behind the production Resend domain.
